description: This file defines the LookupRef class, which provides static methods for various lookup and reference functions similar to Excel functions, such as ADDRESS, COLUMN, ROW, HYPERLINK, INDIRECT, OFFSET, CHOOSE, MATCH, INDEX, TRANSPOSE, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, LOOKUP, and FORMULATEXT. Many methods are deprecated in favor of methods in specific classes within the same namespace. The class acts as a facade to underlying functionality for spreadsheet reference and lookup operations.

classes.name: LookupRef
classes.description: Class providing static methods for spreadsheet lookup and reference functions, many of which are deprecated in favor of more specific classes.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.description: Creates a cell address as text given specified row and column numbers. Calls Address::cell().

methods.name: COLUMN
methods.description: Returns the column number of the given cell reference, calling RowColumnInformation::COLUMN().

methods.name: COLUMNS
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a range, calling RowColumnInformation::COLUMNS().

methods.name: ROW
methods.description: Returns the row number of the given cell reference, calling RowColumnInformation::ROW().

methods.name: ROWS
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a range, calling RowColumnInformation::ROWS().

methods.name: HYPERLINK
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink string, calling LookupRef\Hyperlink::set().

methods.name: INDIRECT
methods.description: Returns a reference specified by a text string, calling Indirect::INDIRECT().

methods.name: OFFSET
methods.description: Returns a reference offset from a cell or range, calling Offset::OFFSET().

methods.name: CHOOSE
methods.description: Selects a value based on index, calling LookupRef\Selection::choose().

methods.name: MATCH
methods.description: Searches for a value in an array, calling LookupRef\ExcelMatch::MATCH().

methods.name: INDEX
methods.description: Returns a value from a range or array using an index, calling Matrix::index().

methods.name: TRANSPOSE
methods.description: Transposes a full matrix, calling Matrix::transpose().

methods.name: VLOOKUP
methods.description: Performs a vertical lookup, calling VLookup::lookup().

methods.name: HLOOKUP
methods.description: Performs a horizontal lookup, calling HLookup::lookup().

methods.name: LOOKUP
methods.description: Performs a general lookup, calling Lookup::lookup().

methods.name: FORMULATEXT
methods.description: Returns the formula text of a cell, calling LookupRef\Formula::text().
